title: Sacs de rechange — Grand Raid de La Réunion 2026
claims: Diagonale des Fous runners get three drop bags, all handed in at Ravine Blanche in Saint-Pierre at the start.
The three collection points are Hell-Bourg at PK 81, Ilet Savannah at PK 140 and the finish at La Redoute.
Each drop bag must weigh no more than 5 kg and must not contain cash, a camera or a mobile phone.
Every bag must carry the runner's name, bib number and destination, plus the barcode label supplied by the organiser.
Dirty clothes can be handed back at an assistance point and are transported to the finish at La Redoute.
Uncollected bags are destroyed 24 hours after the races close for hygiene reasons.
